subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Captivity
solution:
The correct answer is: **Liberty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Captivity"** refers to the state of being imprisoned, confined, or held against one's will. (कैद)
 
 
• **Example:** The bird was kept in captivity until it was released back into the wild.
 
 
• **"Liberty"** refers to the state of being free, having the ability to act or speak without restrictions or confinement. (स्वतंत्रता)
 
 
• **Example:** After years of struggle, the people achieved liberty and were able to govern themselves.
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"Captivity"** is **"Liberty"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Liberty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ethnicity** (जातीयता): Refers to the shared cultural, social, or ancestral heritage of a group of people.
 
 
• **Example:** People of different ethnicities live together harmoniously in this city.
 
 
• **Entity** (अस्तित्व): Refers to something that exists independently, either physically or conceptually.
 
 
• **Example:** The company was treated as a separate legal entity from its owners.
 
 
• **Authenticity** (प्रामाणिकता): Refers to the quality of being genuine or real.
 
 
• **Example:** The authenticity of the ancient artifact was verified by experts.
